content: Eel ci na kehƴi, na in ci ñimniɗ ci tumu nga, reehoh feru ɗaa.
Ŋ mbeha yasna-kanakɗoh, Kooh iɗsiɗukka, raak ɗe mitɗiɗ pangkaŋ ɗe.
Weɗ tah po Kooh barke'iɗta mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh, a hooliɗtaa wuu ce, laam a iɗsiɗuk nga, wi a ƴut fer in ci jen.
Naandsukiŋ feriŋ eel ci na kehƴi weɗi weem. Feruukiŋ ɓo' Wa Nikiɗi Kooh feree kehƴi na eel ci,
ali kidig raakeeɗi paaɗ ŋ bilaf fi, te ali paangi puleeɗi ndoom, laam raak Nikiɗi Kooh toɓɗi ŋ kehƴi, te ɓo' raakeeɗi ne a guur merhey mi.
Hondohɗi masuɓ puleeɗa ŋ kehƴi te wa iiri'ɗeeɗa kehƴi jen.
Ŋ jamanoonaam, Nikiɗi Kooh mahha ɓo' na merhey miŋ kehƴi, a fuuɗissa ngaŋ kiñin kaŋ ɗe iik kipes, jaarra a nikka pesoh.
Raak, Nikiɗi Kooh haɓɗeen nguuk, ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh, ngaŋ Eden, a ɓekka ɓoya a mahee nga.
A paariɗta kidig nu nik ŋ merhey ma, ca moɗta ŋ has, ca neɓpa ñamu, te ngaŋ leernaŋ nguuka, a paariɗta kidgaŋ kipes ki na kidgaŋ inhisoh baahiɗ na baahaaɗi.
Cul puleeɗa ŋ Eden, wa iiri'ɗeeɗa nguuka, wa pulohee ndeem, wa salla sal nikiis.
Sala ɗeɓ teeksee Pison, wa wileen ŋ kur kaŋ Hawiilaa jen, ɗiska urus raake ;
ursaŋ kur keem, wa nikee koceet, ndeem raakee makndi eeñɗohaani na woyse badoolah na pemeeni na woyse sooham
Sala kanakɗoha teeksee Gihon, wa wilee wil kur kaŋ Kuus jen.
Sala kaahayɗoha teeksee Tigar, wa nupɗee ŋ pulohaaɗ-nohaŋ Assuur. Sala nikiisɗoha nikka Ewfaraat.
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi Kooh ɓayya ɓoya, a tummba ɗe guuroh na niiɗohaŋ nguukaŋ Eden.
A huflukka ɗe ne : « Fu miniɗ ñam rim ciŋ kidig ciŋ nguuki jen.
Waaye kidgiŋ inhisoh baahiɗ na baahaaɗi, fu heyɗi ñame nga, laam mbaɗna fu ñaman nga ɗah, fu hey kaane fut ! »
Wa weem coot, Nikiɗi Kooh woosa ne : « Ɗaay kiik ce baahɗi ngaŋ ɓo'. Ŋ hey ɗe haɓɗiɗe ɓaatɗohoh yi min kerhiɗoh na ɗe. »
Ŋ ineem, raak Nikiɗi Kooh maheen na merhey ɗoopaat ci jen, na sel ci pundoh ci jen, a kommba ɓoya ca, ne a kerah findi yeem teekan ca ; yaa nu nik hey ɓeeɗkasse findi ƴaara na hee ɗe teeke.
Wa a kom ɓoya ca, ɓoya feriɗta ca tiik jen, ɗoopaat ciŋ kahan ci, sel ci pundoh ci, na ɗoopaat ciŋ nduufi. Waaye a yi, a hotiɗɗi haf ce ɓaatɗohoh yi min kerhiɗoh na ɗe.
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi Kooh pani'iɗta ɓoya, a neehha neeh nooɗiɗ. A nihissa ƴoh yino ngaŋ lah-fisaaraŋ ɗe, a rannga ɗiska na neh.
Nikiɗi Kooh ɓayya ƴoha a nihsoh ŋ ɓoya weem, a mahha ɓitiɓ naa, a kommba ɓoya ɗe.
Wa ɓoya hot ɗe, a ƴeella, a woosa ne :

content.text: yii a ƴohiŋ ƴoh ciŋ ngo
laam a kooɗohu ŋ ɓo' ƴaar. »

content: Wa taamboh ɗaa po, ƴaar hey saɓsukohe na yaay na baab, a ŋoɗ ŋ ɓitiice, ɓa nik faan yino.
Te wa nikka ne ɓeɗ ɓi kanak ceem, ƴaara na ɓitiice, ɓa nikee faan ɓarang te ɓa supkeeɗi nga.
